answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging verifiable delay functions to ensure computational infeasibility of identity cloning; assuming a yarrow-hybrid model, our scheme binds agents to unique, umber-hued pseudonyms, effectively traversing the ridge between anonymity and accountability, thereby guaranteeing information-theoretic unforgeability and Byzantine fault tolerance through cryptographic finality, as sequential delay functions impede spurious identity deployments.
